notes.title: Those NPC's Love Story Kickstarter Campaign started!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44802144/14e09cd7ecfaf9309fbc949bb8752a762ddf6f0e.gif"][/img][/p][h2][b]Mr.Ryu's new game "Those NPC's Love Stories" game demo has been released, and the Kickstarter campaign has started as well.[/b][/h2][h3]Thanks to all the support, we've reached 60% so far, but there's 40% to go before we reach our goal...[/h3][h3]Please play the game demo and support the project if you find it is fun and you like it.[/h3][h3]Sponsors will also be rewarded for sharing the campaign page.[/h3][h3][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/fymmg/those-npcs-love-stories?ref=bzncfm" style="button"]See the Kickstarter campaign page for details.[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Hunky City Steam Ranking is now open!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44802144/a437474d7676f7bbbad7a080eca54b41bd631c5b.png[/img]
Are you a master of time management?
Now you can upload your in-game playtime to the Steam Leaderboards once you've successfully dated all characters.
The faster you are, the higher your ranking.
Upload your results and see where you rank!
